name: Gather
author: Erin Carter
description: A dominant mother pool of dark liquid mirror with three small satellite droplets orbiting on slow, individually phased cycles; each drifts in, forms a tether neck, is swallowed with a bright snap as she swells, then is reluctantly shed back out along a new bearing — orbiting matter conserved into and out of one body.

params.label: Mother size
params.effect: Base radius of the central pool in css pixels before any swallowed mass is added.

params.label: Orbit speed
params.effect: How fast the satellites circle and how often gulps and sheds come around.

params.label: Gulp flash
params.effect: Brightness of the colour-3 bloom at each swallow and shed; at zero exchanges happen silently.
